snippet.title: Subsequence – Official Trailer | Story Adventure for Android
snippet.description:
Subsequence is a story-driven 3D adventure about exploration, discovery and a touch of dark humor – now available on Android!

By pure coincidence, Vicky finds herself trapped in an underground laboratory after a mysterious incident tied to her brother Vincent's research. Things quickly spiral out of control and she must fight for her life.

🔬 Explore secret labs, a burning elevator shaft, a flooded tunnel… and even outer space
🧩 Solve light logic puzzles – just don't cross the laser beam
🎒 Collect items and hidden collectibles that unlock new features
😄 Tense moments balanced with humor – the game doesn't take itself too seriously
⏱ A compact ~2-hour adventure you can finish in one evening
🌍 13 languages, full English and Czech voice-over

🎧 Best experienced with headphones.

▶ Get it on Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.zoemigames.subsequence
🖥 Also on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1936530/Subsequence/

🌐 Website: http://www.subsequencegame.com/
💬 Discord: https://discord.gg/2zFnFvEsnM

Developed by Zoemi Games.

#Subsequence #indiegame  #androidgames
